product_overview: IOTARU is a public-facing IoT solutions website for exploring smart security, monitoring, automation, products, solutions, and technical articles. It helps visitors browse the catalog, learn about deployment options, and contact the company for inquiries.
core_goals: Browse the full IoT product catalog and inspect individual product details
Explore solution offerings for smart home, smart office, and smart city use cases
Read technical blog articles and guides
Contact the company using the website contact form
Navigate the site easily through the homepage, footer, and responsive menu

features.name: Navigation
features.description: A site-wide navigation experience that lets visitors move between the homepage, products, solutions, blog, and contact pages, with a mobile-friendly slide-in menu.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a navigation link -> See the selected page
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile menu -> Choose a page link -> See the selected page
Navigate to / -> Click the navbar call-to-action -> See the contact page
Navigate to / -> Scroll down the page -> Observe the sticky glass-style navigation effect

features.name: Homepage
features.description: The landing page introduces IOTARU with a hero section, product showcase, technology stack, company information, and supporting content sections.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Wait for the preloader to dismiss -> View the hero section
Navigate to / -> Observe the animated heading and feature highlights -> Scroll through the page sections
Navigate to / -> Interact with the product showcase -> Open a product detail page
Navigate to / -> Scroll through the technology stack and supporting content -> Click a footer link to continue browsing

features.name: Product Carousel
features.description: A horizontally scrollable product showcase on the homepage that highlights featured products and supports direct navigation to product details.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the product carousel navigation arrows -> View the next or previous products
Navigate to / -> Select a dot indicator -> Jump to a specific product in the carousel
Navigate to / -> Scroll horizontally through the showcased products -> View additional product cards
Navigate to / -> Select a product card -> Open the corresponding product detail page

features.name: Product Catalog
features.description: A searchable and filterable catalog that helps visitors browse all products across categories and pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /products/ -> Enter a product name in search -> See the filtered product list
Navigate to /products/ -> Select a category filter -> See products narrowed to that category
Navigate to /products/ -> Clear the search term -> See the full catalog again
Navigate to /products/ -> Expand hidden category filters -> Choose another category -> See the updated results
Navigate to /products/ -> Use pagination controls -> See the next page of products
Navigate to /products/ -> Select a product card -> Open the product detail page

features.name: Product Detail
features.description: An individual product page that presents the product description, image, gallery, and specifications.
user_flows: Navigate to /products/ -> Select a product card -> View the product detail page
Navigate to a product detail page -> Review the description and specifications -> Learn the product details
Navigate to a product detail page -> Select a related product card -> Open another product detail page
Navigate to a product detail page -> Return to the product listing -> Continue browsing

features.name: Solutions Overview
features.description: A solutions landing page that introduces the platform's solution categories and links to detailed solution pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /solutions/ -> View the solution overview content and key stats
Navigate to /solutions/ -> Click the explore solutions link -> Jump to the solution cards section
Navigate to /solutions/ -> Select a solution card -> Open the solution detail page
Navigate to /solutions/ -> Click the contact action -> Open the contact page

features.name: Solution Detail
features.description: An individual solution page that explains a specific solution and its benefits, with links to related solutions.
user_flows: Navigate to /solutions/ -> Select a solution card -> View the solution detail page
Navigate to a solution detail page -> Review the solution description and benefits -> Understand the use case
Navigate to a solution detail page -> Select a related solution -> Open another solution detail page
Navigate to a solution detail page -> Return to the solutions listing -> Continue browsing

features.name: Blog
features.description: A blog section where visitors can browse article listings and read individual technical articles and guides.
user_flows: Navigate to /blog/ -> View the article cards -> Choose an article to read
Navigate to /blog/ -> Select an article card -> Open the full blog post
Navigate to a blog post page -> Return to the blog listing -> Continue browsing articles

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: A contact page with a form for entering inquiry details and launching the user's email client through mailto integration.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact/ -> Fill in the name, email, subject, and message fields -> Submit the form -> See the success message and email client open
Navigate to /contact/ -> Leave a required field blank or enter an invalid value -> Submit the form -> See the validation feedback

features.name: Footer
features.description: A site footer that provides company information and additional navigation links.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the footer -> View the company information
Navigate to / -> Select a footer navigation link -> Open the linked page

Scroll horizontally through products

Click Explore Solutions anchor link
Click Contact Us button
Hover over solution cards
Click solution cards to view details

Navigate back to solutions listing

Wait for preloader to dismiss automatically

View company information

known_limitations.issue: Contact form uses mailto redirect instead of backend API submission
known_limitations.impact: Form opens email client instead of sending data to server

known_limitations.issue: No user authentication or admin dashboard
known_limitations.impact: No protected routes or user management

known_limitations.issue: Product search is client-side URL parameter based, no full-text search backend
known_limitations.impact: Search only filters by product title match

known_limitations.issue: GSAP SplitText is a paid Club GreenSock plugin, may not work in all environments
known_limitations.impact: Hero text animations may not render if SplitText fails to load
